paragraphs.text: Nikko was one of Yorgo 's ruffians in Arathoxia on Dominaria .

Nikko had his throat torn out by a goblin summoned by Jared Carthalion , but was then healed when Jared gave him an alabaster potion to drink. He was later killed by Narok when Jared, Yorgo, and other Arathoxian refugees attacked Castle Melmereth .
Nikko's spirit lingered in the ruins of Melmereth and could be encountered during the Planeswalker War .
